info.name: TableCheck API - V1 availability membership_programs API

params.name: ids
params.description: Array or comma-separated list of specific IDs to return.

params.name: membership_ids
params.description: Array or comma-separated list of specific membership IDs.

params.name: created_at_min
params.description: Search lower bound of created_at field (ISO timestamp).

params.name: created_at_max
params.description: Search upper bound of created_at field (ISO timestamp).

params.name: updated_at_min
params.description: Search lower bound of updated_at field (ISO timestamp).

params.name: updated_at_max
params.description: Search upper bound of updated_at field (ISO timestamp).

params.name: page
params.description: The zero-based page number. Used for pagination.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of items to return at once. Used for pagination.

params.name: include_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response (whitelist). If specified, only the listed fields will be returned. Supports dot notation for nested fields.

params.name: exclude_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to exclude from the response (blacklist). All fields except the given ones will be returned. Supports dot notation for nested fields.

params.name: membership_program_id
params.description: The ID of the Membership Program to retrieve
